source.title: Open problems in infinite-dimensional topology. 1979 version

trace.notes: Normalized the input as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL with trailing identifier 3701785.
Local workflow shard metadata for the same zbMATH identifier records the title as 'Open problems in infinite-dimensional topology. 1979 version' and the year as 1980.

Direct local fetch of https://zbmath.org/3701785 returned an HTTP 403 Cloudflare challenge during the recovery pass, and local shell fetches of api.zbmath.org failed with DNS resolution errors. This established blocked_or_challenged and network_or_dns_failure modes for the zbMATH resolver path.

Exact-work search attempts using the zbMATH identifier and exact title found the Topology Proceedings record and a same-title PDF at https://topology.nipissingu.ca/tp/reprints/v04/tp04128s.pdf, but the local workflow could not download it because the host topology.nipissingu.ca did not resolve from the sandbox. Browser/PDF reads did not expose full text, only search snippets. Other visible candidates, including the 1990 West update and the 2007 Banakh-Cauty-Zarichnyi chapter, were rejected as different works rather than the 1979 Geoghegan version.

No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the technical problem statements was recovered within the bounded pass. The workflow forbids extracting questions from resolver metadata, bibliographic records, abstracts, search snippets, or different works.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/3701785.json and outputs/latest.json.
